newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-FREE STATE BEAT S.E.TRANSVAAL 21-3.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FREE STATE BEAT S.E.TRANSVAAL 21-3.

text.p: Free State reached the semi finals of the Currie Cup by beating South East Transvaal at Free State Stadium on Friday night, but the 21-3 result (half time 12-3) will hardly have probable opponents Natal quaking in their boots.
The home side scored two first half tries through right wing Chris Badenhorst and scrum half Werner Swanepoel, but there was rarely any fluency to the Cheetahs' moves.
They were further set back by a poor kicking display from flyhalf M.J. Smith who at one stage had a record of just one out of eight and finished with four from 11.
South East Transvaal scored first with a penalty from scrum half Dan van Zyl in the fourth minute and the coal miners dominated possession in the first quarter.
But they were let down by handling errors among the backs, while a lack of confidence probably denied them two breakaway tries in the first period.
The one fluent movement of the match down the right wing resulted in Badenhorst's 12th minute try which gave Free State a lead they never relinquished.
Free State will play the winners of Saturday's encounter between Natal and Griqualand West in next week's semi-final.
Result: Free State 21, South East Transvaal 3
Free State - Tries: Chris Badenhorst, Werner Swanepoel. Conversion: M.J.Smith. Penalties: M.J.Smith (3).
South East Transvaal - Penalty: Dan van Zyl.
